title: pilosella kalksburgensis subsp. praelonga
intro: Pilosella kalksburgensis subsp. praelonga, commonly known as a member of the dandelion family, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant is known to have therapeutic actions such as protecting against oxidative stress and inflammation, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
